thread.title: Tech among market's biggest gainers, but Facebook continues to drag - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: Tech among market's biggest gainers, but Facebook continues to drag - MarketWatch
text: U.S. stocks rose broadly on Monday, as concerns over the prospect of a trade war appeared to fade. The day's gains were widespread, with all 11 of the primary S&P 500 sectors higher on the day. Leading the day's advance, however, was the financial sector, which climbed 2.7%. Technology also outperformed on the day, adding 2.5%. Among the biggest gainers of the financial sector, Goldman Sachs GS, +2.51% climbed 2.5% while Morgan Stanley MS, +3.05% Bank of America BAC, +3.03% and JPMorgan Chase & Co. JPM, +3.13% were all up more than 3%. In the tech sector, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +5.47% surged 5.5% in its biggest one-day percentage jump since October. Separately, Apple Inc. AAPL, +2.74% gained more than 2%. Weighing on the tech sector, however, was Facebook FB, -1.54% which fell 2% as the biggest decliner among S&P 500 components. The social-media giant continues to weather the fallout from a scandal about how it has handled user data. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +2.00% climbed 1.9% while the S&P 500 SPX, +1.75% jumped 1.7% and the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.91% was up 1.9%.
